prompts.text: Describe a scene for your team to draw. Be vivid — and drawable.
Give one-line instructions to draw the office mascot.
Describe something from your childhood for the team to draw.
Describe the perfect workspace in one sentence.
Give instructions to draw your favorite emoji, without naming it.
Describe a fictional creature for the team to draw.
Describe the view from your desk (real or imagined).
Give one line to draw the team's spirit animal.
Describe a food so the team can draw it.
Describe your dream vacation scene in one sentence.
Give instructions to draw 'chaos' as a picture.
Describe the last meme you saw so the team can draw it.
